thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: throughput degradation + p99 spikes in eu-central-1 (model-ensemble) detected for the last 4m. Paging oncall.

Marcus (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping in. Which pools/variants are affected? @Hana @Elise

Hana (infra): Looks concentrated on eu-central-1 pool-3 serving model-ensemble-v2-q8. Recent deploy_at=1999992000 included a quantized kernel swap and a micro-optim to kernel selection.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: infra/runtime-kernels@rev-ffa123 (1999992000) -> rolled to eu-central-1 pool-3.

Elise (sre): Seeing large tail latencies and a sudden drop in effective throughput. Error rate slightly up (timeouts ~0.8% vs baseline 0.02%). Pulling a few logs.

Hana (infra): Prometheus snippets:
```\n# queries over last 5m\nsum(rate(request_duration_bucket{le=\"0.5\"}[5m])) by (pool)\n>> eu-central-1-pool3: 0.35 (baseline 0.86)\n\nsum(rate(request_duration_bucket{le=\"2.0\"}[5m])) by (pool)\n>> eu-central-1-pool3: 0.78 (baseline 0.98)\n```
We have heavy shift to long tails; also cpu steal on pod node-n12 at ~12% unusual.

Marcus (oncall): Node CPU-steal could indicate noisy neighbor or underlying host issue. Can we drain the pod to another node as quick mitigation? Also revert kernel swap for this pool if possible.

Hana (infra): Initiating quick mitigation plan: 1) cordon+drain node-n12 for pool3, 2) rollback kernel rev on pool3 to previous rev-ead33. Running: `rdwctl pool update pool3 --kernel rev=ead33 --priority=hotfix`

Elise (sre): While that runs, enable a circuit-breaker to route traffic away from model-ensemble-v2-q8 to model-ensemble-v2-fallback (slightly larger memory, unquantized) to protect latency-sensitive customers. Configure policy: 20% traffic shift to fallback for 30m.

Marcus (oncall): Good. Raj, pls prepare a brief customer note for affected EU customers and queue to post on status page once mitigation shows progress.

Raj (support): Draft: 
"We are aware of increased request latency and occasional timeouts affecting inference in EU Central. Engineers have rolled back a recent kernel change for the affected capacity pool and rerouted a portion of traffic to a fallback model. We expect progressive recovery; we'll update within 30 minutes."

(2m later)
Hana (infra): Rollback command completed. Node drain also completed and pods rescheduled. Logs show kernel version ead33 active on all pool3 pods.

Elise (sre): Early metrics: p99 dropped from ~2.8s -> 0.9s, timeouts down. Throughput still ~80% of baseline due to 20% fallback routing. Error rate back to ~0.05%.

Marcus (oncall): Nice. Post status page now (use Raj text). Add impact severity: "Partial degradation - latency and brief timeouts for subset of requests in EU Central" and ETA: "full recovery as traffic shifts and nodes stabilize in 30-60 minutes."

Raj (support): Posted to status page and queued direct messages to customers flagged by our support filters. DM template: 
"Hi — we're investigating increased inference latency in EU Central. We've applied mitigations (kernel rollback + traffic redistribution). Latency is improving; we will follow up in 30 minutes. If you're seeing persistent errors please reply and we'll escalate"

Marcus (oncall): Handing monitoring to Elise in 20m. Handoff notes: root cause likely kernel regression interacting poorly with our KV cache/quantized path; mitigation was rollback + fallback routing; open infra ticket INF-2026-999 to track permanent fix (test coverage + canary automation).

Elise (sre): Taking over monitoring. I'll check the canary traces and look for cache warming issues on the fallback. Also will verify autoscaler hasn't been influenced.

(10m later)
Elise (sre): p95 ~ 220ms, p99 ~ 0.7s steady, timeouts minimal. Fallback route reduced to 10% to test. No regressions observed.

Hana (infra): Note: the drained node had a noisy hypervisor process causing CPU steal spikes; infra will quarantine node-n12 and run host diagnostics.

Marcus (oncall): Good catch. For postmortem: include timeline, the kernel change, host-level interference, and mitigations. Also add recommended playbook step: for kernel swaps, run staged canary across pools and verify KV/cache-hit synergy.

Raj (support): Customers notified; two have replied asking for logs and ETA. I pointed them to the status page and the ongoing rollback. Marked both as high priority.

deploy-bot: NOTE: incident ticket INC-2026-888 created and assigned to Marcus for postmortem.

Marcus (oncall): Wrapping handoff. Elise will keep an eye for the next 30 minutes and I'll own the postmortem write-up. Thanks everyone.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: Metrics stable for 45m; p99 back within baseline. INC-2026-888 remains open for postmortem and infra follow-up.
